Class MersenneTwister

java.lang.Object
random.engine.RandomEngine
random.engine.MersenneTwister
public class MersenneTwister extends RandomEngine

    • setNewSeed

      public void setNewSeed(long seed)
      Description copied from class: RandomEngine
      Sets the seed of the default engine of uniform random number. WARNING: this method must be called only by the class Simulation and only before starting the simulation, otherwise the engine is seeded using the current time.
      Specified by:
